html:
Ceramic paint coating is a clear liquid polymer that bonds to the paint on your car offering superior durability & protection compared to traditional waxes and sealants.

How ceramic paint coating differs from waxes and sealants is that waxes & sealants form a barrier on top of the paint, whereas ceramic paint coatings bond with the car’s paint becoming part of the finish. Ceramic paint coating for cars also lasts much longer too.

Because ceramic paint coating is so durable, it can also help to preserve the value of your car. If you decide to sell your car down the road, the buyer will be able to see that it has been well-maintained and protected against wear & tear.

Overall, a ceramic paint coating is a great way to protect your investment and keep your car looking its best for years to come!

What Are The Benefits Of Ceramic Paint Coating?

Benefits of a ceramic paint coating for cars include:

  • Increased durability: A ceramic paint coating can make your car’s paint more resistant to scratches and chips
  • Protection from surface damage caused by bird droppings, tree sap and bugs
  • Increased shine and gloss: A ceramic coating will make your car’s paint look shinier and more lustrous.
  • Protection from UV rays: A ceramic coating will protect your car’s paint from UV damage, which can cause fading.
  • Easy to clean: A ceramic-coated car is easier to clean than a non-coated car. Water and dirt will bead up on the surface and be easily removed.

The ceramic coating also creates a Teflon-like non-stick surface allowing you to simply wipe spills away and is suitable for use on fabric, vinyl, leather, and plastic surfaces.

How Do You Care For Ceramic Paint Coating?

To care for your ceramic coating, you will need to wash your car regularly with a soap designed specifically for coated cars. You should also avoid using harsh chemicals or cleaners on your car’s surface. When drying your car, be sure to use a soft microfiber cloth to avoid scratching the surface.

By taking proper care of your ceramic coating, you can enjoy the benefits of having protected paint for years to come.
